<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Skip EXIF orientation normalization when the model uses the mistral tokenizer, so vLLM's image decode matches the decode performed by the mistral_common chat template. Fixes #62420.

## Claims

- Fixes the HTTP 500 `Expected there to be 1 prompt placeholders ... found 0` raised when serving EXIF-oriented images (orientations 6/8) to models run with `--tokenizer-mode mistral`.
- Removes the silent pixel-layout inconsistency for orientation 3 (180°): vLLM now feeds the same pixel layout that mistral_common's chat template computed the `[IMG]` token grid from.
- No behavior change for any other model: `normalize_orientation` defaults to `True` and the gating only applies to mistral-tokenizer models.

## Validation

**Unit tests** (8 new test cases in 4 files, run on `main` @ `1a5b187066`, CPU):

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/renderers/chat_utils/test_item_tracker.py \
  tests/multimodal/media/test_connector.py \
  tests/multimodal/media/test_image.py \
  tests/multimodal/test_parse.py -q
# 134 passed, 1 skipped

VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/renderers/chat_utils/ tests/renderers/test_mistral.py -q
# 187 passed

VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/models/multimodal/processing/test_mistral3.py -q
# 27 passed, 8 skipped

VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/multimodal/ -q
# 452 passed; 5 failures in test_video.py are pre-existing on base
# (codec/backend issues, verified on pristine main)
```

Both test dirs are covered by existing Buildkite pipelines (`tests/multimodal`, `tests/renderers`).

**E2E validation on a production-like deployment** (1x H100 80GB, docker `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly` @ `49cb2bbf71` = `0.32.0rc1.dev281`, with this patch applied as 5 read-only file mounts. The image's 5 target files are byte-identical to this branch's base commit, so the served code is exactly this branch. Model: Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506-FP8, mistral format, `--tokenizer-mode mistral`):

Original failing request (real Samsung EXIF-6 photo, 2 MB, German document Q&A payload, streamed):

| Server | Result |
|---|---|
| unpatched nightly | HTTP 500, placeholder error |
| patched (this PR) | HTTP 200, 338 SSE chunks, `finish_reason: stop` |

EXIF orientation matrix (640x480, identical pixels, only the orientation tag differs; question: "where is the yellow sun: top/bottom/left/right?"):

| Orientation | unpatched | patched | expected (raw layout) | observed (patched) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 200 | 200 | top | top |
| 3 | 200 (but answers "Bottom" — normalized layout, inconsistent with the mistral_common decode) | 200 | top | Top |
| 6 | **500** | 200 | top | top |
| 8 | **500** | 200 | top | top |

Non-mistral regression (Pixtral-12B HF format, standard tokenizer, same patched overlay — EXIF normalization must still apply; expected = viewer layout after transpose, computed with PIL's `exif_transpose`):

| Orientation | result | expected | observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 200 | top | Top |
| 3 | 200 | bottom | Bottom |
| 6 | 200 | right | right |
| 8 | 200 | left | Left |

Concurrency/latency (40 parallel requests: 20 text / 10 plain image / 10 EXIF-6):

| Server | errors | p50 | p95 |
|---|---|---|---|
| unpatched | 10 (every EXIF-6 request 500s) | 3.18s | 4.08s |
| patched | 0 (40/40 OK) | 3.57s | 4.55s |

(The patched latency includes 10 additional requests that now complete; the tokenizer check goes through the existing `lru_cache`, no measurable overhead.)

## Details

**Root cause.** With `--tokenizer-mode mistral`, the prompt is rendered by mistral_common's chat template, which decodes image bytes itself — without applying EXIF orientation normalization. vLLM's `ImageMediaIO.load_bytes` (loading path introduced in #44974) applies `normalize_image` (EXIF transpose). For orientations that swap width/height (6/8), the image token grid computed from the two decodes differs, so `_find_mm_placeholders` finds 0 `[IMG]` placeholders for 1 image item → 500. Related history: #44974 (load-time EXIF transpose), #47566 (normalize direct PIL inputs), #52874 (Mistral3 placeholder grid, different cause).

**Fix.** Make vLLM's decode agree with mistral_common's on this path:

- `vllm/tokenizers/registry.py`: new `uses_mistral_tokenizer()` helper (reuses the existing cached resolver, so the check resolves once).
- `vllm/renderers/chat_utils/item_tracker.py`: when the model uses the mistral chat template, the tracker injects `normalize_orientation=False` into the image `media_io_kwargs`.
- `vllm/multimodal/media/image.py`: `ImageMediaIO` gains a `normalize_orientation` flag (default `True`) gating `normalize_image` in `load_bytes`.
- `vllm/multimodal/parse.py` + `vllm/multimodal/processing/context.py`: the same flag (`normalize_image_orientation`, default `True`) for PIL images passed directly, wired to `not is_mistral_tokenizer(...)`.

**Trade-offs.** Mistral-tokenizer models now see the raw stored pixel layout (identical to the mistral_common reference stack) instead of the viewer-normalized one; EXIF normalization is unchanged for all other models. The alternative — normalizing inside mistral_common — is out of tree and would change the reference behavior.

**Not duplicating existing work.** Searched open PRs/issues for "EXIF orientation", "normalize_image mistral", "mistral prompt placeholders" — no open PR addresses this tokenizer/EXIF interaction; the three related merged PRs above do not cover it.

**AI assistance.** This change was developed with AI assistance (GLM-5.3 via OpenCode); the fix, tests, and validation were reviewed and re-run by the human submitter.

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

+def _make_exif_jpeg(orientation: int) -> bytes:
+    """Build a 40x20 JPEG whose EXIF orientation tag is `orientation`."""
+    image = Image.new("RGB", (40, 20), (255, 0, 0))
+    exif = image.getexif()
+    exif[274] = orientation

+def test_fetch_image_normalize_orientation_media_io_kwargs():
+    """media_io_kwargs can disable EXIF normalization; used for the Mistral
+    path, whose chat template re-decodes images from their source bytes."""
+    data_url = "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(_make_exif_jpeg(6)).decode(
+        "utf-8"
+    )
+
+    default = MediaConnector().fetch_image(data_url)
+    assert default.size == (20, 40)
+
+    connector = MediaConnector(
+        media_io_kwargs={"image": {"normalize_orientation": False}}
+    )
+    stored = connector.fetch_image(data_url)
+    assert stored.size == (40, 20)
